text:
maya: heads-up — intermittent decode "glint" (weird token repeats / garbage) on AWQ act-quant runs. Seen in staging on g5 x2, group_size=64, act_q=1.
liam: which model/version? can you paste a failing sample?
sophia: 1769000000 — model: redwood-open-13b-v1 (candidate). sample below.
sophia: ```
Input: "Summarize the privacy policy in one sentence."
Output (bad): "policy policy policy policy policy policy policy"
Log snippet: WARN decode_loop: repeated_token_penalty triggered many times
Tensor check: act_quant_scale contains zeros for some channels
```
zayn: is this on the AWQ-enabled runtime or standard GPTQ build?
maya: AWQ runtime, latest canary image (awq-runtime:2026-03-12). Only seen after the ACT quant pass.
eva: quick sanity: try group_size=32 or disable act quant (act_q=0) and repro. if it disappears, act quant + large group size interaction likely.
bench-bot: perf snapshot: group_size=64 + act_q=1 => 48 tok/s median, p95 latency 520ms. group_size=32 + act_q=1 => 44 tok/s, p95 480ms. group_size=16 + act_q=0 => 39 tok/s p95 420ms.
liam: can you reproduce locally with a single GPU and `--seed=42`? sometimes seed flips expose randomness.
sophia: repro steps I used: `python -m serve --model redwood-open-13b-v1 --quant awq --group-size 64 --act-quant 1 --port 8080`. attaching short run log.
sophia: ```
[run] init awq kernels
[run] apply_act_quantization -> scale_min=0.0 scale_max=4.0
[decode] step 12 logits: contains nan
[decode] fallback to fp32 path
```
maya: interesting — fallback happened but client still got repeated tokens. maybe kv-cache state corrupted?
eva: potential root cause: per-group activation scales computed with underflow when channel sums small -> zeros in scale -> divide issues. we saw similar on int8 experiments earlier.
zayn: quick test idea: clip activation scales to >= 1e-6 before quantizing. also try per-channel unfolding instead of per-group for a patch.
liam: i can run a small sweep tonight: group_size in [16,32,48,64], act_q in [0,1], clip_eps in [1e-8,1e-6,1e-4]. will report metrics (accuracy delta, p95).
maya: status — rolled canary back to group_size=16 on staging, incidents down. opening a tracking bug: infra/awq-serve-345.
deploy-bot: rolled back canary redwood-open-13b-v1@canary -> group_size=16 at 2026-03-12T21:45Z :white_check_mark:
bench-bot: baseline eval (L14 benchset): group_size=64 act_q=1 -> bleu -1.8, ppl +12% vs fp32. group_size=16 act_q=0 -> bleu -0.4, ppl +3%.
sophia: adding a unit test: create synthetic micro-batch with tiny activations and assert scale >= eps. i'll PR a fix with clipping and a config flag `awq.act_clip_eps`.
eva: also add a canary metric for "repeated_token_rate" in the console for AWQ models. set alert threshold to 0.5% over 10m.
maya: thanks team. next steps: liam runs sweep, sophia PRs clip + test, eva adds alert, i'll coordinate rollback notes and customer comms. :thumbsup:
